content: 'Ixaheri xiɨyarimama kememɨte'uti'inɨatsie

Merikɨtsɨ Yawé Muitsexi kaniutahɨawe, 'ixuriki tukiyari manuwe, Tsinahi mɨrakutewa makumawetsie, mexɨakame tukaritsie hutarieka metseriyaritsie, kepauka 'ixaheritsixi 'Ekipitu memayewitɨkie huta wiyari 'anuyemiekakuri. Mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe:
«Yunaime keniwaraka'utɨa mana kiekatari, 'Ixaheri xiɨyarimama meta nuiwarimama yuxexuitɨ kememɨyɨpapaɨme, yunaime 'ukitsi kememɨtetetewa xewaraka'utɨwatɨ yuxexuime.
'Ekɨ, 'Aruni hamatɨa xekaniwaraka'utɨakuni 'ixaheritsixi waniwema yunaime 'ukitsi kuyakɨ 'aixɨa memɨ'anene, xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨka.
'Ikɨ xemɨwati'inɨatakɨ xeime xekanita'inikuni wa'ukiyari mɨkɨ yuxexuime wanuiwaritsie mieme manuyeka.
Memɨhɨritɨarie memɨwaka'utɨanikɨ
»'Ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni kemɨ'ane memɨxeparewieni:
Xuweni xiɨyarimama hetsiemiemete, 'Eritsuxi Tserehuxi nu'aya,
Tsimehuni xiɨyarimama, Tserumieri Tsuritsarahi nu'aya,
Kura xiɨyarimama, Nahatsuni 'Aminarawi nu'aya,
'Itsakaxi xiɨyarimama, Natanaheri Tsuhaxi nu'aya,
Tsawuruni xiɨyarimama, 'Eriyawi Heruni nu'aya,
Kutse nu'aya xiɨyarimama hetsiemiemete: 'Eritsama 'Amihuri nu'aya, 'Epɨrahini xiɨyarimama hetsiemiemete meta Manatsexi xiɨyarimama Kamarieri Peratsuxi nu'aya,
Wenikamini xiɨyarimama hetsiemiemete, 'Awirani Kerehuni nu'aya,
Rani xiɨyarimama, 'Akihetsexi 'Amitsarahi nu'aya,
'Atsexi xiɨyarimama, Pakieri 'Ukɨrani nu'aya,
Kahari xiɨyarimama hetsiemiemete, 'Eriyatsati Rehuheri nu'aya,
Nepɨtahari xiɨyarimama hetsiemiemete, 'Akira 'Enahani nu'aya».
'Ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni kiekatari memanuyeyaxe, memaka'utɨarie nuiwarite kememɨtehɨkɨ meta kuyaxi 'Ixaheritsixi tewa'aitɨwamete.
Memaka'utsie kememutipaɨmerixi
Hikɨ Muitsexi, 'Aruni hamatɨa 'ukitsi mekaniwarukuxeɨrieni memɨwaraka'utɨanikɨ kememɨtetetewatɨka memanayexeiyarie wahetsie,

hutarieka metseriyaritsie 'itsutɨakaku yunaime kiekatari mekaniwarukuxeɨrieni. Yuxexuitɨ mekanaka'utsieni hakewa memeyenunuiwaxɨ kemɨ'ane memɨtehaxiɨyari. 'Ana mekanaka'utuarieni yunaitɨ 'ukitsi xeitewiyari wiyari memexeiyatɨka,
Muitsexi yakatinikayani, Yawé kemɨtita'aitɨakai. 'Ikɨ Muitsexi kaniwaraka'utɨani Tsinahi 'uyeikatɨ makumawatsie.

Xuweni xiɨyarimama, 'Ixaheri matɨarieya, mekanaka'utsieni kemɨ'ane memutehaniwema meta memɨtehaxiɨyarima, kehepaɨ memɨte'ununuiwaxɨ. Yunaitɨ 'ukitsi xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨka mekanaka'utɨarieni kuyaxikɨ 'aixɨa memɨ'anenekai memɨyɨwawe.
Xuweni xiɨyarimama huta tewiyari heimana 'ataxewi miriyari heimana 'auxɨwi tsienituyari (46.500) 'ukitsi mekanakɨne.

Tsimehuni xiɨyarimamata mekanaka'utsieni kemɨ'ane memutehaniwema meta kemɨ'ane memɨtehaxiɨyarima, kehepaɨ memɨte'ununuiwaxɨ. Yunaitɨ 'ukitsi xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨka mekanaka'utɨarieni kuyakɨ 'aixɨa memɨ'anene.
Tsimehuni xiɨyarimama huta tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'atanauka miriyari heimana haika tsienituyari (59.300) 'ukitsi mekanakɨne.

Kahari xiɨyarimama mekanaka'utsieni kemɨ'ane memɨtehaniwema meta memɨtehaxiɨyarima, kehepaɨ memɨte'ununuiwaxɨ. Yunaitɨ 'ukitsi xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨka mekanaka'utsieni kuyaxikɨ 'aixɨa memɨ'anenekai.
Kahari xiɨyarimama huta tewiyari heimana 'auxɨwi miriyari heimana 'ataxewime tsienituyari heimana huta tewiyari heimana tamamata (45.650) 'ukitsi mekanakɨne.

Kura xiɨyarimama mekanaka'utsieni kemɨ'ane memɨtehaniwema meta memɨtehaxiɨyarima, kehepaɨ memɨte'ununuiwaxɨ. Yunaitɨ 'ukitsi xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨkatei mekanaka'utsieni kuyakɨ 'aixɨa memɨ'anene.
Kura xiɨyarimama haika tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana nauka miriyari heimana 'ataxewime tsienituyari (74.600) 'ukitsi mekanakɨne.

'Itsakaxi xiɨyarimama mekanaka'utsieni kemɨ'ane memɨtehaniwema meta kemɨ'ane memɨtehaxiɨyarima, kehepaɨ memɨte'ununuiwaxɨ. Yunaitɨ 'ukitsi xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨkatei mekanaka'utsieni kuyakɨ 'aixɨa memɨ'anene.
'Itsakaxi xiɨyarimama huta tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana nauka miriyari heimana nauka tsienituyari (54.400) 'ukitsi mekanakɨne.

Tsawuruni xiɨyarimama mekanaka'utsieni kemɨ'ane memɨtehaniwema meta kemɨ'ane memɨtehaxiɨyarima, kehepaɨ memɨte'ununuiwaxɨ. Yunaitɨ 'ukitsi xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨka mekanaka'utsieni kuyakɨ 'aixɨa memɨ'anene.
Tsawuruni xiɨyarimama huta tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'atahuta miriyari heimana nauka tsienituyari (57.400) 'ukitsi mekanakɨne.

Kutse xiɨyarimama: 'Epɨrahini xiɨyarimama mekana'utsieni kemɨ'ane memutehaniwema meta kemɨ'ane memɨtehaxiɨyarima, kehepaɨ memɨte'ununuiwaxɨ. Yunaitɨ 'ukitsi xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨkatei mekanaka'utsieni kuyakɨ 'aixɨa memɨ'anene.
'Epɨrahini xiɨyarimama huta tewiyari miriyari heimana 'auxɨwime tsienituyari (40.500) 'ukitsi mekanakɨne.

Manatsexi xiɨyarimamata mekanaka'utsieni kemɨ'ane memɨtehaniwema meta memɨtehaxiɨyarima, kehepaɨ memɨte'ununuiwaxɨ. Yunaitɨ 'ukitsi xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨkatei mekanaka'utsieni kuyakɨ 'aixɨa memɨ'anene.
Manatsexi xiɨyarimama xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana huta miriyari heimana huta tsienituyari (32.200) 'ukitsi mekanakɨne.

Wenikamini xiɨyarimama mekanaka'utsieni kemɨ'ane memɨtehaniwema meta memɨtehaxiɨyarima, kehepaɨ memɨte'ununuiwaxɨ. Yunaitɨ 'ukitsi xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨkatei mekanaka'utsieni kuyakɨ 'aixɨa memɨ'anene.
Wenikamini xiɨyarimama xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'auxɨwi miriyari heimana nauka tsienituyari (35.400) 'ukitsi mekanakɨne.
Rani xiɨyarimama mekanaka'utsieni kemɨ'ane memɨtehaniwema meta memɨtehaxiɨyarima, kehepaɨ memɨte'ununuiwaxɨ. Yunaitɨ 'ukitsi xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨka mekanaka'utsieni kuyakɨ 'aixɨa memɨ'anene.
Rani xiɨyarimama haika tewiyari heimana huta miriyari heimana 'atahuta tsienituyari (62.700) 'ukitsi mekanakɨne.

'Atsexi xiɨyarimamata mekanaka'utsieni kemɨ'ane memɨtehaniwema meta memɨtehaxiɨyarima, kehepaɨ memɨte'ununuiwaxɨ. Yunaitɨ 'ukitsi xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨkatei mekanaka'utsieni kuyakɨ 'aixɨa memɨ'anene memɨkamama.
'Atsexi xiɨyarimama huta tewiyari heimana xewi miriyari heimana 'auxɨwime tsienituyari (41.500) 'ukitsi mekanakɨne.

Nepɨtahari xiɨyarimama mekanaka'utsieni kemɨ'ane memutehaniwema meta memɨtehaxiɨyarima, kehepaɨ memɨte'ununuiwaxɨa. Yunaitɨ 'ukitsi xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨka mekanaka'utsieni kuyakɨ 'aixɨa memɨ'anene.
Nepɨtahari xiɨyarimama huta tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana haika miriyari heimana nauka tsienituyari (53.400) 'ukitsi mekanakɨne.

Merikɨte 'ipaɨ yupaɨmetɨ mekanakɨne kepauka Muitsexi 'Aruni hamatɨa memɨwaraka'utɨatsie, mewaparewiekaku 'Ixaheri xiɨyarimama tamamata heimana huta meyupaɨmetɨ, mɨkɨ yuxexuitɨ yunuiwari hetsiemieme mekaniyɨakaitɨni.
Yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi xeitewiyari wiyari memɨhɨtɨkatei, kuyakɨ 'aixɨa memɨ'anene mekanaka'utsieni, kememɨyupaɨmekai nuiwarite.
Yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi memaka'utsie, 'ataxewime tsienituyari heimana haika miriyari heimana 'auxɨwime tsienituyari heimana huta tewiyari heimana tamamata (603.550) meyupaɨmetɨ mekanakɨne.
Rewitsixi
Rewitsixi teɨteriyari mepɨkahaka'utɨarie hipame wahamatɨa,
matsi Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ mɨtiutahɨawekaikɨ:
«Rewi xiɨyarimama pepɨkawaraka'utɨani, 'Ixaheri niwemama wahamatɨa memɨkayutinɨnɨwenikɨ.

'Aixɨa kaniyɨmɨkɨ, 'ekɨ pemɨwahɨritɨanikɨ tɨratu tukita mayeka hepaɨtsita meta naime hepaɨtsita ketipaɨmetɨ muwa mɨtiyepine kemɨtiyukumaɨwa. Rewitsixi Kakaɨyari tukieya mepɨ'ɨwiyani naime muwa mɨtiyepine. Yaxeikɨa yuheyemekɨ muyepatsietsie mekatene'uximayakakuni 'ahurawa memakuteitsie meheitayeme.
Kepauka tukieya xemanukwenitsie rewitsixi xeikɨa mekanitaxɨnakuni, kepauka memeitawewienitsie mɨkɨ xeikɨa mekaneyɨakakuni. Kemɨ'ane 'ahurawa mauyani tukieya manuka kamawari wewiwametɨtɨ kanemɨmɨkɨ.
Yunaitɨ 'ixaheri teɨteriyari yateewa mekanikuyaxixɨakuni yuxexuitɨ me'ukutetɨkaitɨ yupatera mehexeiyatɨkaitɨ kememɨteyunuiwari.

Hikɨ rewitsixi tɨratu tukita manuka 'aurie mekanikuyaxikuni, 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie xemɨnuakakɨ kepauka Kakaɨyari ha'atɨ wahetsie munuani. Merikɨ rewitsixi xeikɨa mekanihɨkɨtɨkakuni tɨratu tukita hepaɨtsita tehɨwemete».
Hikɨ naimekɨ 'ixaheritsixi yamekatenikakɨne Yawé Muitsexi kemɨtiuta'aitɨa.
